purpose: Fix-ledger ids accepted as claiming a released status their page does not show. This is a RATCHET: an id in it that has become truthful is reported stale and must be removed, and an id not in it is a hard failure. It may only shrink. It is deliberately EMPTY - npm run recover:fix-ledger-truthfulness reconciled all 668 rows that predated the guard, so the gate runs at zero tolerance rather than around a permanent allowance.
